title: Question for Mark: should query --at bound tiers by start date?
description: tier_at (vouch-faq3.3) follows export/allowed_signers: tiers have no start bound, so a tier granted after TIME counts at TIME (gregkh promoted 2026-05-01 reads maintainer at 2026-03-01), and a handle that was automation until T1 and is now human reads automation=false at T0<T1, so the bridge rule (valid, emails, not automation) would authorize a bot-era signature. DESIGN says the bridge answers 'as of that time' and automation is 'never' authorized. Options: (a) keep export model (documented in tier_at docstring); (b) bound tiers by record date/history for query only; (c) at least set automation=true if an automation tier was held at TIME. Decide before vouch-faq3.4 ships; then add a hand-written promotion-after-TIME test.
notes: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-22): (b). query --at derives the tier held at TIME from the registry's git history (tier record added/changed/removed), for query only; export unchanged (answers now). Covers promotion-after-TIME, automation-until-T1, and demotion. DESIGN gets one line: query and export can differ for past times. Then add hand-written promotion-after-TIME and automation-era tests to faq3.3/faq3.4.
close_reason: Mark chose (b): tiers at TIME from git history, query only
